propositions: scc_loc.analyze() invokes scc via subprocess.run with --format json and parses the JSON payload to extract per-file LOC, returning AnalyzerResult with loc dict keyed by repo-relative POSIX paths and max_loc field
scc_loc.py is self-contained in analyzers/ package with no dependency on rebar.grounding, avoiding cross-layer coupling between metrics and grounding
The adapter fails closed (returns Unavailable) when scc binary is missing, process exits non-zero, stdout is empty, or JSON is unparseable, and emits a warning log
Successful empty output (empty JSON array) returns AnalyzerResult with empty files dict and max_loc=0, not Unavailable
The scc JSON parser flattens two levels (language groups and per-file entries) and extracts Code and Location fields from each file entry
The run parameter is injectable to allow tests to provide canned scc JSON output without requiring a live scc binary
